body:
⚓ Anchor Overlay

Anchor Overlay is a simple and useful resource pack made especially for Crystal PvP players. This pack changes the appearance of Respawn Anchors so you can quickly identify their charge level during fights without needing to check closely.

The pack uses different colors for each charge stage, making Anchor PvP easier, faster, and more comfortable. Whether you are practicing, playing ranked matches, or fighting in competitive Crystal PvP, this overlay helps you understand an anchor's charge level at a glance.

Features

• 🟣 Purple Anchor = 0 Charges (Empty)

• 🔴 Red Anchor = 1 Charge

• 🟠 Orange Anchor = 2 Charges

• 🩷 Pink Anchor = 3 Charges

• 🟢 Green Anchor = Full Charge

With these color changes, you can instantly recognize how many times an anchor has been charged with Glowstone. This helps improve reaction time and reduces mistakes during intense PvP battles.

Why Use This Pack?

• Easy to understand color system

• Designed specifically for Crystal PvP

• Helps identify anchor charge levels quickly

• Clean and simple overlay design

• Useful for both beginners and experienced players

• Improves awareness during fights

This pack focuses on visibility and practicality rather than flashy effects, making it a great choice for players who want a clean PvP experience.

Information

Pack Design By: Ray Senpai

Pack Type: Anchor Overlay

Best Used For: Crystal PvP

If you're looking for a simple overlay that makes Anchor PvP easier and more efficient, Anchor Overlay is a great addition to your resource pack collection. Enjoy faster charge recognition and a cleaner PvP experience with this lightweight and easy-to-use pack. ⚓
